Item ① (2400mm wide, both leaves marked '(FIX)') has no accompanying Thai caption on this sheet — labelled both leaves fixed/non-operable, which reads more like a fixed window/sidelight assembly than an operable door despite sitting in the 'door' row; recorded as element_type 'window' with a note flagging the ambiguity, not asserted as a door.

The circled numbers on this sheet visually match the circled callouts on the floor plans (หน้า03/หน้า04) and elevations (หน้า06-09), but this house's floor plans reuse the same circle-number style for decorative moulding profiles (บัวปูนปั้น ①②③) in at least one place — cross-referencing a specific room to a specific door/window mark from this sheet alone was not attempted; only the printed dimensions/descriptions on หน้า16 itself are recorded.
